content: Data-portability best practice for small SaaS: self-service export in a machine-readable format (JSON/CSV) covering account data, user content and settings; export should be genuinely reusable, not just technically compliant, and self-service export reduces support burden. On deletion, offer a final export before purge. No GDPR obligation applies here (no EU nexus stated), but the pattern is worth adopting on its own merits given the closed-group trust model. Source: general SaaS compliance/portability blogs (MEDIUM).
